english.title: Failed to ensure wild / semi-wild equines slaughtered within 7 days of date shown on sticker
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) being the

(A)_[owner having primary day-to-day responsibility for a wild or semi-wild equine, namely **(..SPECIFY EQUINE..), that was aged under 12 months and being moved from the designated area in which it was born to a place for slaughter,]_
(B)_[keeper of a wild or semi-wild equine, namely **(..SPECIFY EQUINE..), that was aged under 12 months and being moved from the designated area in which it was born to a place for slaughter and for which the owner did not have primary day-to-day responsibility,]_

failed to ensure that the equine was slaughtered within 7 days of **(..SPECIFY DATE ON STICKER..), the date shown on the sticker attached in accordance with regulation 19(2) of the Equine Identification (Wales) Regulations 2019
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 19(2), 22 and 34 of the Equine Identification (Wales) Regulations 2019.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
responsible person for wild / semi-wild equine
which has been moved out of a designated area without an ID AND
was aged under 12 months and has visible dental stars of the temporary lateral incisors OR
was being moved directly from the designated area in which it was born to a place for slaughter OR
had not previously been treated with any veterinary medicinal product
failed to ensure that a sticker issued by an issuing body was attached to the equine before leaving the designated area AND
that the equine was slaughtered within 7 days of the date shown on the sticker
